domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into cabudges. Here are the actions I can do

   Mentan a block
   Uncabudge a block from on top of another block
   Grafor a block
   Cabudge a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only mentan or uncabudge one block at a time.
   I can only mentan or uncabudge a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only mentan a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not mentanned.
   I can only uncabudge a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncabudging was really on top of the other block.
   I can only uncabudge a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncabudging is clear.
   Once I mentan or uncabudge a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only grafor a block that I am holding.
   I can only cabudge a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being cabudged.
   I can only cabudge a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am cabudging the block is clear.
   Once I grafor or cabudge a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you cabudge a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Expring a block
   Unjectition a block from on top of another block
   Bagrend a block
   Jectition a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only expring or unjectition one block at a time.
   I can only expring or unjectition a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only expring a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not expringed.
   I can only unjectition a block from on top of another block if the block I am unjectitioning was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unjectition a block from on top of another block if the block I am unjectitioning is clear.
   Once I expring or unjectition a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only bagrend a block that I am holding.
   I can only jectition a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being jectitioned.
   I can only jectition a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am jectitioning the block is clear.
   Once I bagrend or jectition a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you jectition a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Once I cloogize or wastin a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you wastin a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Egate a block
   Unphrate a block from on top of another block
   Cloint a block
   Phrate a block on top of another block

   I can only egate or unphrate one block at a time.
   I can only egate or unphrate a block if my hand is empty.

   Once I egate or unphrate a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only cloint a block that I am holding.
   I can only phrate a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being phrated.
   I can only phrate a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am phrating the block is clear.
   Once I cloint or phrate a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you phrate a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Fendin a block
   Undiouet a block from on top of another block
   Niente a block
   Diouet a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only fendin or undiouet one block at a time.
   I can only fendin or undiouet a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only fendin a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not fendinned.
   I can only undiouet a block from on top of another block if the block I am undioueting was really on top of the other block.
   I can only undiouet a block from on top of another block if the block I am undioueting is clear.
   Once I fendin or undiouet a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only niente a block that I am holding.
   I can only diouet a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being dioueted.
   I can only diouet a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am dioueting the block is clear.
   Once I niente or diouet a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you diouet a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Mahand a block
   Unstitize a block from on top of another block
   Evanny a block
   Stitize a block on top of another block

   I can only mahand or unstitize one block at a time.
   I can only mahand or unstitize a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only mahand a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not mahanded.
   I can only unstitize a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstitizing was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unstitize a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstitizing is clear.
   Once I mahand or unstitize a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only evanny a block that I am holding.
   I can only stitize a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being stitized.
   I can only stitize a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am stitizing the block is clear.
   Once I evanny or stitize a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stitize a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Lementor a block
   Unfendin a block from on top of another block
   Dinate a block
   Fendin a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only lementor or unfendin one block at a time.
   I can only lementor or unfendin a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only lementor a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not lementorred.
   I can only unfendin a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfendinning was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unfendin a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfendinning is clear.
   Once I lementor or unfendin a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only dinate a block that I am holding.
   I can only fendin a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being fendinned.
   I can only fendin a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am fendinning the block is clear.
   Once I dinate or fendin a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you fendin a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   I can only fermon a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am fermonning the block is clear.
   Once I symplity or fermon a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you fermon a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Bunkle a block
   Unenchipict a block from on top of another block
   Wareat a block
   Enchipict a block on top of another block

   I can only bunkle or unenchipict one block at a time.
   I can only bunkle or unenchipict a block if my hand is empty.

   I can only unenchipict a block from on top of another block if the block I am unenchipicting was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unenchipict a block from on top of another block if the block I am unenchipicting is clear.
   Once I bunkle or unenchipict a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only wareat a block that I am holding.
   I can only enchipict a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being enchipicted.
   I can only enchipict a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am enchipicting the block is clear.
   Once I wareat or enchipict a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you enchipict a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Spitive a block
   Unnention a block from on top of another block
   Appeous a block
   Nention a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only spitive or unnention one block at a time.
   I can only spitive or unnention a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only spitive a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not spitived.
   I can only unnention a block from on top of another block if the block I am unnentioning was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unnention a block from on top of another block if the block I am unnentioning is clear.
   Once I spitive or unnention a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only appeous a block that I am holding.
   I can only nention a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being nentioned.
   I can only nention a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am nentioning the block is clear.
   Once I appeous or nention a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you nention a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into insions. Here are the actions I can do

   Chorch a block
   Uninsion a block from on top of another block
   Cloint a block
   Insion a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only chorch or uninsion one block at a time.
   I can only chorch or uninsion a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only chorch a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not chorched.
   I can only uninsion a block from on top of another block if the block I am uninsioning was really on top of the other block.
   I can only uninsion a block from on top of another block if the block I am uninsioning is clear.
   Once I chorch or uninsion a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only cloint a block that I am holding.
   I can only insion a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being insioned.
   I can only insion a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am insioning the block is clear.
   Once I cloint or insion a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you insion a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into lementors. Here are the actions I can do

   Laberley a block
   Unlementor a block from on top of another block
   Royager a block
   Lementor a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only laberley or unlementor one block at a time.
   I can only laberley or unlementor a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only laberley a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not laberleyed.
   I can only unlementor a block from on top of another block if the block I am unlementorring was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unlementor a block from on top of another block if the block I am unlementorring is clear.
   Once I laberley or unlementor a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only royager a block that I am holding.
   I can only lementor a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being lementorred.
   I can only lementor a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am lementorring the block is clear.
   Once I royager or lementor a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you lementor a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Mirate a block
   Unvadelinde a block from on top of another block
   Borden a block
   Vadelinde a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only mirate or unvadelinde one block at a time.
   I can only mirate or unvadelinde a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only mirate a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not mirated.
   I can only unvadelinde a block from on top of another block if the block I am unvadelinding was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unvadelinde a block from on top of another block if the block I am unvadelinding is clear.
   Once I mirate or unvadelinde a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only borden a block that I am holding.
   I can only vadelinde a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being vadelinded.
   I can only vadelinde a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am vadelinding the block is clear.
   Once I borden or vadelinde a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you vadelinde a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into chimates. Here are the actions I can do

   Aiminial a block
   Unchimate a block from on top of another block
   Builed a block
   Chimate a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only aiminial or unchimate one block at a time.
   I can only aiminial or unchimate a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only aiminial a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not aiminialed.
   I can only unchimate a block from on top of another block if the block I am unchimating was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unchimate a block from on top of another block if the block I am unchimating is clear.
   Once I aiminial or unchimate a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only builed a block that I am holding.
   I can only chimate a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being chimated.
   I can only chimate a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am chimating the block is clear.
   Once I builed or chimate a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you chimate a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into bivalls. Here are the actions I can do

   Approfity a block
   Unbivall a block from on top of another block
   Vess a block
   Bivall a block on top of another block

   I can only approfity or unbivall one block at a time.
   I can only approfity or unbivall a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only approfity a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not approfitied.
   I can only unbivall a block from on top of another block if the block I am unbivalling was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unbivall a block from on top of another block if the block I am unbivalling is clear.
   Once I approfity or unbivall a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only vess a block that I am holding.
   I can only bivall a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being bivalled.
   I can only bivall a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am bivalling the block is clear.
   Once I vess or bivall a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you bivall a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into bonumes. Here are the actions I can do

   Profice a block
   Unbonume a block from on top of another block
   Nephilt a block
   Bonume a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only profice or unbonume one block at a time.
   I can only profice or unbonume a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only profice a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not proficed.
   I can only unbonume a block from on top of another block if the block I am unbonuming was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unbonume a block from on top of another block if the block I am unbonuming is clear.
   Once I profice or unbonume a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only nephilt a block that I am holding.
   I can only bonume a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being bonumed.
   I can only bonume a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am bonuming the block is clear.
   Once I nephilt or bonume a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you bonume a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into fowleys. Here are the actions I can do

   Slotot a block
   Unfowley a block from on top of another block
   Habisetty a block
   Fowley a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only slotot or unfowley one block at a time.
   I can only slotot or unfowley a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only slotot a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not slototted.
   I can only unfowley a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfowleying was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unfowley a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfowleying is clear.
   Once I slotot or unfowley a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only habisetty a block that I am holding.
   I can only fowley a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being fowleyed.
   I can only fowley a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am fowleying the block is clear.
   Once I habisetty or fowley a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you fowley a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Once you braine a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Snoran a block
   Unpourbalk a block from on top of another block
   Ekendes a block
   Pourbalk a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only snoran or unpourbalk one block at a time.
   I can only snoran or unpourbalk a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only snoran a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not snoranned.
   I can only unpourbalk a block from on top of another block if the block I am unpourbalking was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unpourbalk a block from on top of another block if the block I am unpourbalking is clear.
   Once I snoran or unpourbalk a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only ekendes a block that I am holding.
   I can only pourbalk a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being pourbalked.
   I can only pourbalk a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am pourbalking the block is clear.
   Once I ekendes or pourbalk a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you pourbalk a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into [verb_3][plural]. Here are the actions I can do

   [verb_1][capitalize] a block
   [negate][verb_3][capitalize] a block from on top of another block
   [verb_2][capitalize] a block
   [verb_3][capitalize] a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only [verb_1] or [negate][verb_3] one block at a time.
   I can only [verb_1] or [negate][verb_3] a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only [verb_1] a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not [verb_1][past].
   I can only [negate][verb_3] a block from on top of another block if the block I am [negate][verb_3][progressive] was really on top of the other block.
   I can only [negate][verb_3] a block from on top of another block if the block I am [negate][verb_3][progressive] is clear.
   Once I [verb_1] or [negate][verb_3] a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only [verb_2] a block that I am holding.
   I can only [verb_3] a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being [verb_3][past].
   I can only [verb_3] a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am [verb_3][progressive] the block is clear.
   Once I [verb_2] or [verb_3] a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you [verb_3] a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.
